nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Payday happened. ACTUAL payday. Mabel restocked, the farmers are seeding, and somebody left a pie on my workbench, which is a safety hazard I've decided to allow.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Mm. Heavy saddlebags on the ride home, I heard.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: The eyebrow says what the Code says, only quieter. You'll square it. You always do — eventually.

nodes.speaker: Doc Vega
nodes.text: Structurally sound. Rhubarb. Whoever built it understood load-bearing crusts.
